fields/current_provider_summary.json.method: Baseline TOP3 reused only when all selected offers are nonhistorical. Affected origin/family pairs recomputed against the entire nonhistorical provider subset on the same directed graph.

fields/graph_summary.json.proof: For any directed origin path of cost <=H, each nonnegative prefix costs <=H; all of its vertices belong to the forward multisource union. Induced routing preserves all such paths. Administrative boundaries do not restrict the graph.

organisation/summary.json.interpretation: Concentration diagnostics; no service membership or mandatory nested functional hierarchy follows from these tables.
organisation/summary.json.method: Outgoing neighbour comparisons; explicit external halo; direct-time comparison between successive smoothing scenarios.
